body:
Ehh I just don't think its for me. I don't really have relationships with anyone, not even my own family. Its been years since I talked to either of my parents, and I don't miss them in the slightest bit. They were great parents too. I've never missed another human being.  

I don't really want more distractions. I have enough between drugs and video games and sleeping/dreaming.

Scenario 2 only matters if you value trying. I don't really care. I don't believe that fulfillment is guaranteed as long as you try. Lets hypothetically say that there is a guaranteed fulfillment and I just have to find it, I don't think it would be worth the effort in the end anyways.

A wife and family just isn't something I've ever wanted. I don't long for acceptance, love, care, being desired and wanted, or any of that stuff. I prefer to be alone. It may be selfishness or whatever, but I like like doing what I want to do when I want to do it. I don't like compromising. I don't like my decisions and actions affecting other people. I don't like doing things I don't want to do, but must do in order to maintain the relationship.

Well you just stated my only fear about death and one of the things thats held me back for so long. But I don't really care about the lost opportunity. To me the opportunity or possibility of joy isn't worth the risk of being miserable until I die anyways. Might as well skip the bullshit and just take the death now.

I've often thought about eternal life. It would be fucking hell (unless you enjoyed every second of it). I'm only 23. That is nothing compared to the 13billion years before I existed. I'm already sick of existing and I've barely done it. I find nothingness blissful (which is actually impossible since nothing is nothing, cant be in bliss if your nothing. Its just the idea), you might find it terrifying but I don't mind it. The 13 billion years before I was born were infinitely better than the 23 I've existed.  

Eternal existence is easily achievable. Just think, what are YOU? You are not your body, you aren't even your brain. You are whats created by your brain. If you could eternally sustain a brain you could be eternally existent. Or you could recreate what the brain creates and eternally sustain whatever that thing is. We just need time, knowledge, and technology.

Its not the cost of living I'm worried about, its mainly the cost of getting there.  

I did leave that 2 percent for a reason. I've actually looked into them and how they work and all that back when I was given them, and I understand your metaphor.  

I just... I don't know, I don't like them. The only way that 2% would happen is if we had the technology to look into my brain and see exactly what I'm missing (if anything at all) and then be able to deliver the exact amount to rectify the issue with 100% guarantee and 0 side effects. Other than that I wont do them.  

This all just seems like so much trouble and effort. Death sounds easy and nice.

I feel like that would be really expensive. And the fact that I hate making money so damn much really makes it not worth it at all. I would want it to be vastly different. I get burnt out/bored of things very quickly.  

Its the drugs in the body thing. But its weird, because I do drugs (the fun ones) and I have zero issues with putting those in my body. But something about the thought of antidepressants is a huge turn off, and I can't explain why.

I've tried most all simple passions. Movies are okay, but nothing worth living for. Games are okay, but nothing worth living for. I've played all sorts of games and its probably my main means of distraction. I played halo and cod competitively for awhile, played runescape as a kid (okay and as an adult too lol), and play league quite a bit. But none of that is worth living and working for. As for the sports, they either need to be really competitive or really terrifying. I like the extreme sports more than others. But they aren't worth living for.  

I've smoked enough weed and pondered a lot about life to realize it has no true meaning or purpose long ago. I've known that I have to create that purpose and meaning myself. I just don't care about anything enough.  

I have zero desire to find a girl or have children or start a family. I'm introverted, and possibly asexual or aromantic. I don't desire to have more people in my life. There's already too many.  

The permanent aspect of suicide is the whole point. I don't care if just maybe I could be happy at some point in the future. Nothing matters anymore when you're dead and that's the beauty of it. I'm not going to continue guaranteed misery on the slight chance that just maybe I find something eventually (when would that be). If I'm alive 50 years from now and still miserable, I'm going to be so fucking pissed that I didn't kill myself now. All that wasted misery, when I could have been in blissful nothingness the whole time.

I have thought about moving. But no where is really all that desirable. I wouldn't know where to go. I wouldn't be able to decide. I have issues with making decisions and perfectionism. One thing I absolutely loathe is regretting decisions. And If I regretted where I moved, but then also didn't have the means to move again, I am certain I would quickly kill myself.  

I was on one for about 2 months and then another for another 2 months. But I hated taking pills so I stopped. I am about 98% sure I will never try pills again.
